international.headline: India and Vietnam to observe 2027 as the Year of India–Vietnam Friendship
facts: India and Vietnam decided at the 19th India–Vietnam Joint Commission Meeting in New Delhi in September 2026 to observe 2027 as the Year of India–Vietnam Friendship, marking 55 years of diplomatic relations.
The meeting was co-chaired by India’s External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar and Vietnamese Foreign Minister Le Hoai Trung.
The countries plan to expand cooperation in trade, investment, supply chains, market access, financial links, maritime and air connectivity, space and nuclear energy.
The stated trade target is USD 25 billion by 2030.

Diplomatic relations began in 1972; the countries established a Strategic Partnership in 2007, a Comprehensive Strategic Partnership in 2016 and an Enhanced Comprehensive Strategic Partnership in 2026.

international.headline: India and Germany sign declaration on wetland conservation
facts: India and Germany signed a Joint Declaration of Intent in New Delhi in September 2026 on conserving and wisely using wetlands of international importance.
Union Environment Minister Bhupender Yadav and German Minister Carsten Schneider signed it at the 4th Indo-German Environment Forum, themed “Together for More Resilience.”
The declaration aims to strengthen sustainable wetland management, biodiversity conservation and climate resilience.

The Ramsar Convention was adopted at Ramsar, Iran, on 1971-02-02 and entered into force in 1975; its three pillars include wise use, Ramsar Site designation and management, and international cooperation.
The Montreux Record lists Ramsar Sites where changes in ecological character have occurred, are occurring or are likely to occur due to human interference.
international.summary: The declaration sets a framework for India–Germany cooperation in wetland management, biodiversity conservation and resilience, using the Ramsar concept of wise use.
international.staticLink: The Ramsar Convention’s pillars are wise use of wetlands, designation and management of Ramsar Sites, and international cooperation.
international.prelimsTakeaway: The 4th Indo-German Environment Forum theme was “Together for More Resilience”; the Montreux Record concerns ecological-character changes at Ramsar Sites.
international.mainsAngle: Explain how international cooperation and the Ramsar framework can support wetland conservation alongside sustainable use.

international.headline: Gender Snapshot–2026 finds no SDG–5 target on track for 2030
facts: UN Women and the United Nations Department of Economic and Social Affairs released Gender Snapshot–2026 in September 2026.
The report found that none of the Sustainable Development Goal 5 targets was on track for achievement by 2030.
Women held 27.4% of national parliamentary seats in 2026, compared with 22.3% in 2015; women’s share in local government remained around 35.6% since 2023.
About 2.9 billion women and girls lived in countries with high or very high exposure to climate change and geophysical hazards.
At the current pace, the report estimated that achieving gender equality could take another 171 years.
international.summary: The UN report warned that progress across SDG 5 remains insufficient to meet its 2030 targets and highlighted climate exposure and representation gaps.
international.staticLink: Sustainable Development Goal 5: achieve gender equality and empower all women and girls by 2030.
international.prelimsTakeaway: Gender Snapshot–2026 was released by UN Women and UN DESA; it reported no SDG–5 target on track.

national.canonicalTopic: Joint Parliamentary Committee to examine FCRA Amendment Bill 2026
national.headline: 31-member JPC formed to examine FCRA Amendment Bill–2026
facts: Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla constituted a 31-member Joint Parliamentary Committee in September 2026 to examine the Foreign Contribution (Regulation) Amendment Bill, 2026.
Sanjay Jaiswal was appointed Chairperson; the committee has 21 Lok Sabha members and 10 Rajya Sabha members.
The committee is to consider proposed changes relating to foreign-contribution regulation and transparency, voluntary and social organisations, national security and financial accountability.
The JPC is required to report to the Lok Sabha by the last day of the first week of the 2026 Winter Session.
The Foreign Contribution (Regulation) Act, 2010 regulates acceptance and use of foreign contributions or foreign hospitality; the Ministry of Home Affairs is its nodal ministry.
Article 118 empowers each House of Parliament to make rules regulating its procedure and conduct of business.

national.headline: Union Cabinet approves GOBARdhan National Circular Bioenergy Scheme
facts: The Union Cabinet approved the GOBARdhan – National Circular Bioenergy Scheme with an outlay of ₹23,731 crore; the notes say it is effective from 2026-09-01 and will run from 2026–27 to 2035–36.
The scheme aims to generate around 1.5 lakh jobs and convert agricultural residues, cattle dung, press mud, municipal organic waste and other biomass into clean energy and organic manure.
It aims to make Compressed Biogas a major component of the future energy system and increase domestic production by nearly tenfold.
The scheme seeks to attract private investment, strengthen the circular bioeconomy and support rural employment, incomes and the clean-energy transition.
GOBARdhan stands for Galvanizing Organic Bio-Agro Resources Dhan and was initially launched in 2018.

national.canonicalTopic: PM-SETU investment approvals for ITI clusters
national.headline: ₹735.70 crore approved for three PM-SETU ITI cluster plans
facts: At the fifth National Steering Committee meeting under PM-SETU in September 2026, investment plans totalling ₹735.70 crore were approved for three ITI clusters.

The approved plans were ₹241 crore for Bhiwadi in Rajasthan, submitted by H.G. Infra Engineering Limited; ₹254.30 crore for Medchal in Telangana, submitted by Zen Technologies Limited; and ₹240.40 crore for Meerut in Uttar Pradesh, submitted by NSDC.

PM-SETU means Pradhan Mantri Skilling and Employability Transformation through Upgraded ITIs and is administered by the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship.
The programme aims to modernise ITIs, align vocational training with industry needs and improve employability through an industry-partnership hub-and-spoke model.

national.canonicalTopic: KAL long-range one-way attack drone trials
